_statuses_note: Statuses wish_*, ee_*, de_plus, ws_boost, frost, robe_* added from datamine tokens; flat DoT ticks (Fire Wall 650-2059, Frostbite 472-1497 per tick r1-r25) cannot be expressed as an ATK ratio.
_procs_note: Only fire-mark is a proc: 20% x (55% ATK + 32..674 flat) per Fire cast on a Fire-Marked target (datamine tokens abe:1571000011), fired per cast (the game fires per hit; its 1 s cooldown is not in the rank data). NOT modelled on purpose: Grace of Enhancement's 50% x (18% ATK + 106..297) extra hit and Vitality Evaporation's 39% ATK + 261..662 hit (target HP above 70% at rank 1, 51% at rank 20, token abe:1580000011:value11), both with a 1 s internal cooldown. The engine fires procs per cast with no internal cooldown, which would reward spamming cheap skills and inflates their share (they pushed tests/test_rotation.py damage shares to 76%). Absorb Essence (25 MP per attack at rank 1, cd 1 s; aion2.app 15760000) is also not modelled: the research description has the amount blanked and a rule's mp_restore must match the description text (tests/test_data_build.py).

spec_notes: Overrides only where the generic parser is wrong or has no value. Chain children share the root's specialty set and are neutralised (no double counting). Unquantified (kept unknown, listed by tests): Multi-Hit (no value in any official source), Delayed Damage after 3s (Blaze), Enhanced Frostbite / Enhanced Embers (DoT amount is flat and not modelled). Slot ranks stay 8/12/20 (datamine option unlocks 8/8/8/12/16 for actives, 5/10/15/20 for stigmas).
